system.name: IncEventGS
system.one_liner: Incremental pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction from a single event camera that jointly optimises Gaussians and a continuous camera trajectory.

content.variant_note: a differentiable-rendering loop drawn as one scene: Gaussians and a continuous camera trajectory render two brightness images whose log difference is compared with accumulated events by a loss, with black operation arrows, blue gradient arrows and a bootstrapping loop with a depth model
content.argues: Gaussians and a continuous camera trajectory are optimised jointly from chunks of an event stream by comparing rendered with measured brightness change, bootstrapped by a pretrained depth model.
content.subject: An event-stream chunk, the 3D Gaussian scene, a camera trajectory with control knots, rendered brightness images, event losses and a depth-model bootstrapping loop

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a render-and-compare method as one scene: the learned scene in the middle, the measured input and the synthesised output side by side with a loss node, black operation arrows and blue gradient arrows in parallel along each link, and every arrow and glyph decoded in a key at the edge.
lessons.suits: Methods trained by rendering and comparing, such as NeRF, 3D Gaussian splatting, SLAM or inverse graphics, where gradients flow back through a renderer to scene and camera parameters.

evidence: IncEventGS processes incoming event stream by dividing it into chunks and representing the camera trajectory as a continuous model.
Two brightness images are rendered from 3D-GS at the corresponding poses
a pre-trained depth estimation model estimates depth from the rendered images to bootstrap the system

summary: IncEventGS is an incremental, pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction algorithm that uses a single event camera. Figure 1 draws its pipeline as one scene. A large greyscale Gaussian render of a room sits in the middle. At the left, an event-stream cuboid along a Time arrow has an orange chunk between two timestamps that is accumulated into an event image E(x). At the lower right, a continuous camera trajectory with red control knots carries two camera frustums whose rendered brightness images are subtracted in the log domain to give a synthesised event image, compared with E(x) through an MSE/SSIM loss. Black arrows are operations, blue arrows gradients and dashed arrows initialisation through a bootstrapping loop with a pretrained Marigold depth model, all decoded in a key.
summary_zh: IncEventGS 用单个事件相机增量重建 3D 高斯。图以灰度高斯点云为中心：左侧事件流累积成 E(x)，右下轨迹上的两个视锥渲染亮度图并取对数差，与 E(x) 比较损失；黑箭头运算、蓝箭头梯度、虚线为深度初始化。
notes: Prior kinds kept (model-anatomy, stage-pipeline) with the objective-graph variant. The red and blue dots in the event stream and the event images are not decoded in the key (probably the two event polarities). The digest's 13 bitmaps include the Gaussian render (193 x 150 pt), the depth map, the event-stream box, the event images and the rendered images; the key's small glyphs are bitmaps of 11 to 13 pt. The Marigold depth network is a five-bar glyph, not a labelled box. The index calls the type diagram/workflow; the drawing is one scene rather than a flowchart.
